subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Sharat is always ______ about showing up for work because he believes that tardiness gets us nowhere.
solution:
The correct answer is '**punctual**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**punctual**" means happening or doing something at the agreed or proper time; on time. (समय पर)
 
• Being punctual is essential in professional settings to demonstrate reliability and respect for others' time.
 
• The other options: "selective," "patient," and "drowsy" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Sharat is always punctual__ about showing up for work because he believes that tardiness gets us nowhere.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Selective (चयनात्मक)**: means having the function or power of selecting; making a choice.
 
• **Patient (धैर्यवान)**: means able to accept or tolerate delays, problems, or suffering without becoming annoyed or anxious.
 
• **Drowsy (नींद से भरा हुआ)**: means being sleepy or lethargic.

3d:T9d5,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
